title: Seeds for Spring

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: Here is a secret: these seeds are for the spring. If we sow them now, in the warm glasshouse, they'll be ready to plant out when the snow melts.

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: Three seeds in each pot, please. Then we must be patient.

steps.speaker: elias
steps.prompt: Put three seeds in each pot. Count as you go: one, two, three.
steps.hint: Find a pot with an empty dip, and put a seed there.

older.prompt: Four seeds in each pot this time, and six pots. Count them yourself.

feedback.full: That pot has its seeds. Try the next one.
feedback.all_good: Five pots of three: fifteen seeds, sleeping until spring.

outro.speaker: elias
outro.text: Now we wait. In a few weeks, these will be strong little plants, ready to share when spring comes.

outro.speaker: elias
outro.text: Thank you for these two weeks of patient work, my friend. Peace go with you.

journal_line: I sowed seeds in pots for the spring at the monastery.

outro.speaker: elias
outro.text: Six pots of four: twenty-four seeds! Patience will turn them into a garden.

outro.speaker: elias
outro.text: Thank you for these two weeks of patient work, my friend. Peace go with you.
